description: This file defines a service class `MessagingService` for handling incoming SMS and MMS messages in an Android application. It extends `IntentService` and processes intents with specific actions related to receiving messages, delegating processing and wakelock management to `MessagingReceiver`.

classes.name: MessagingService
classes.description: A background service for processing incoming SMS and MMS messages to prevent long processing times in the receiver context.

methods.name: MessagingService
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the IntentService with the name 'MessagingService'.

methods.name: onHandleIntent
methods.description: Processes incoming intents and delegates message handling based on intent action, ensuring wakelocks are released.
